description: This file defines classes and constants for managing Chromium protocol connections and sessions within the Playwright testing framework. It includes CRConnection, CRSession, and CDPSession classes, handling message passing, session management, and connection lifecycle.

classes.name: CRConnection
classes.description: Manages a connection to the Chromium remote debugging protocol, handling message sending, receiving, and session management.

classes.name: CRSession
classes.description: Represents a session within a CRConnection, allowing command execution and message handling.

classes.name: CDPSession
classes.description: A higher-level session class for interacting with Chrome DevTools Protocol targets, supporting attach/detach and event handling.

methods.name: _rawSend
methods.description: Sends a protocol message with a specific session ID, method, and parameters.

methods.name: _onMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming protocol messages, routing them to the appropriate session.

methods.name: _onClose
methods.description: Handles connection closure, cleaning up sessions and emitting disconnect events.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the connection if not already closed.

methods.name: createBrowserSession
methods.description: Creates a new CDPSession attached to the browser target.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a protocol command within a session.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the CDPSession from the target.

methods.name: attachToTarget
methods.description: Attaches a new CDPSession to a specific target ID.
